title: The 4-Hour Workweek
author: Timothy Ferriss
summary: Tim Ferriss lays out a method for escaping the standard working life by automating income, outsourcing tasks and taking mini-retirements, built on his experience running an online business.
readIf: you want a bold, energetic prompt to rethink how and where you work.
skipIf: you want advice that suits a conventional career or distrust get-rich-quick style claims.
